description: Daejeon Highway Stereo Dataset is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Yoonjin Hwang. This dataset includes highway driving scenes in Daejeon, South Korea.Position, Velocity, and Attitude and Inertial Measurements in the perspective of vehicle body frame (obtained by high precision INS OxTS RT3100)Stereo Images @20Hz from global shutter camera (FLIR blackfly-s)Industrial Grade Inertial Measurements aligned with camera coordinate (xsens 670-g)Consumer Grade GNSS (Ublox M8)All data is formatted with ... Coverage: national (KR); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
